items.q: is my document private and secure?
items.a: absolutely. we use industry-standard encryption to process your documents. your files are only used to generate the analysis and are never shared, sold, or used to train public ai models. you can delete your analysis history at any time.

items.q: does this replace a real lawyer?
items.a: no. contractchill is an ai assistant designed to help you understand legal jargon, spot obvious red flags, and prepare for negotiations. it is not a substitute for professional legal advice. for high-stakes agreements, we always recommend consulting a qualified attorney.

items.q: what document formats do you support?
items.a: currently, we support standard text-based formats including pdf, docx, and txt up to 10mb. please note that image-only pdfs (scanned documents without selectable text) or password-protected files cannot be analyzed.

items.q: how accurate is the ai analysis?
items.a: our system is powered by google gemini ai and is highly capable of identifying standard legal risks and summarizing complex clauses. however, like all ai, it may occasionally miss nuanced context specific to your unique business situation.

items.q: what are the different ai personas?
items.a: we offer four distinct perspectives: the 'chill friend' for simple summaries, the 'angry lawyer' for aggressive risk detection, the 'corporate mentor' for strategic business advice, and the 'freelancer senior' for independent worker protections.
